title: Mars destroyed by a CME and plasma events, Valles Marineris

tellings.quote: then weakens and I believe that is what caused the entire destruction of Mars

plain: Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient history, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2024 that Mars was ruined long ago by a huge blast from the Sun. He means a coronal mass ejection, a giant burst of charged gas the Sun throws off, along with electrical plasma events, and he links this to Valles Marineris, an enormous canyon on Mars. He believes this is what caused the entire destruction of Mars, which would mean the Sun can wipe out a whole planet's surface.
